citations.quote: As the name implies, linear regression assumes a linear relationship between the dependent and the independent variables.
Regression analysis is a tool for examining this type of issue.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Principal components analysis (PCA) rotates a standardised feature matrix onto orthogonal axes ranked by explained variance; the analyst keeps enough leading components to cover a chosen cumulative-variance threshold and discards the rest. PCA is not in CFA L1 2022 Quantitative Methods; R7 only covers simple linear regression with its scalar predictor.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Principal Components / Dimensionality Reduction

citations.quote: Principal components are a sequence of projections of the data, mutually uncorrelated and ordered in variance.
Xv2 has the highest variance among all linear combinations satisfying v2 orthogonal to v1, and so on.
